/*vega:archive-metadata*/
SELECT statarena_app.archive_source_fence($1) AS source_fence,
 (SELECT jsonb_build_object('version',version,'revision',revision,'source_fence',source_fence,
  'competitions',competitions,'summary',summary,'match_count',match_count)
 FROM statarena_app.archive_read_editions WHERE season=$1) AS projection
source:
/*vega:archive-edition*/
WITH editions AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT resource_id,scope,source_digest,updated_at,response_status
  FROM statarena_app.catalog_editions
  WHERE catalog='archive-season' AND edition=$1 AND scope IN ('results','goals')),
expected_editions AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT 'results' AS scope FROM statarena_app.catalog_editions idx
  JOIN statarena_app.cat_archive_results_index_seasons s ON s.resource_id=idx.resource_id
  WHERE idx.catalog='archive-index' AND idx.scope='results' AND idx.edition='' AND s.id=$1
  UNION SELECT 'goals' AS scope FROM statarena_app.catalog_editions idx
  JOIN statarena_app.cat_archive_goals_index_seasons s ON s.resource_id=idx.resource_id
  WHERE idx.catalog='archive-index' AND idx.scope='goals' AND idx.edition='' AND s.id=$1),
result_headers AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT c.record_no,c.position,c.id,c.name,c.country,c.missing,c.null_groups
  FROM editions e
  JOIN statarena_app.cat_archive_results r ON r.resource_id=e.resource_id
  JOIN statarena_app.cat_archive_results_competitions c ON c.resource_id=r.resource_id AND c.parent_no=r.record_no
  WHERE e.scope='results' AND NOT 'competitions'=ANY(r.missing) AND NOT 'competitions'=ANY(r.null_groups)
), goal_headers AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT c.record_no,c.position,c.id,c.name,c.country,c."calendarYear",c.missing,c.null_groups
  FROM editions e
  JOIN statarena_app.cat_archive_goals r ON r.resource_id=e.resource_id
  JOIN statarena_app.cat_archive_goals_competitions c ON c.resource_id=r.resource_id AND c.parent_no=r.record_no
  WHERE e.scope='goals' AND NOT 'competitions'=ANY(r.missing) AND NOT 'competitions'=ANY(r.null_groups)
)
SELECT
  statarena_app.archive_source_fence($1) AS source_fence,
  (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(e ORDER BY e.scope),'[]'::json) FROM editions e) AS editions,
  (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(scope ORDER BY scope),'[]'::json) FROM expected_editions) AS expected_scopes,
  (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(c ORDER BY c.position),'[]'::json) FROM result_headers c) AS result_headers,
  (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(m ORDER BY m.parent_no,m.position),'[]'::json) FROM (
    SELECT m.parent_no,m.position,m.date,m."dateNote",m.round,m.team1,m.team2,
      m.score_et,m.score_final,m.score_ft,m.score_p,m.status,
      m."sourceFields_neutral",m."sourceFields_nonmatch",m.missing,m.null_groups
    FROM editions e
    JOIN statarena_app.cat_archive_results_competitions_matches m ON m.resource_id=e.resource_id
    JOIN result_headers c ON c.record_no=m.parent_no
    WHERE e.scope='results' AND NOT 'matches'=ANY(c.missing) AND NOT 'matches'=ANY(c.null_groups)
  ) m) AS result_matches,
  (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(c ORDER BY c.position),'[]'::json) FROM goal_headers c) AS goal_headers,
  (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(g ORDER BY g.parent_no,g.position),'[]'::json) FROM (
    SELECT g.parent_no,g.position,g.date,g.match,g.minute,g.player,g.score,
      g."scoreDisagreement",g."sourceSeason",g.team,g.missing
    FROM editions e
    JOIN statarena_app.cat_archive_goals_competitions_events g ON g.resource_id=e.resource_id
    JOIN goal_headers c ON c.record_no=g.parent_no
    WHERE e.scope='goals' AND NOT 'events'=ANY(c.missing) AND NOT 'events'=ANY(c.null_groups)
  ) g) AS goal_events
page:
/*vega:archive-page*/
WITH live AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT statarena_app.archive_source_fence($1) AS source_fence),
 published AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT p.* FROM statarena_app.archive_read_editions p,live
  WHERE p.season=$1 AND p.version=$2 AND p.revision=$7 AND p.source_fence=live.source_fence
 ), totals AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN $4='' THEN CASE WHEN $3='all' THEN p.match_count ELSE coalesce(
   (SELECT (c->>'matches')::integer FROM jsonb_array_elements(p.competitions) c WHERE c->>'id'=$3 LIMIT 1),0) END
   ELSE (SELECT count(*)::integer FROM statarena_app.archive_read_matches m WHERE m.season=$1
    AND ($3='all' OR m.competition_id=$3)
    AND (position($4 IN m.search_teams)>0 OR position($4 IN m.search_players)>0)) END AS total
  FROM published p
 ), bounds AS (
  SELECT total,greatest(1,ceil(total::numeric/$6::integer))::integer AS pages,
   least($5::integer,greatest(1,ceil(total::numeric/$6::integer))::integer) AS page FROM totals
 )
 SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM published) AS ready,
  (SELECT jsonb_build_object('total',total,'pages',pages,'page',page,'limit',$6::integer,'hasMore',page<pages) FROM bounds) AS pagination,
  (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(rows.listing ORDER BY rows.ordinal),'[]'::jsonb) FROM (
   SELECT m.ordinal,m.listing FROM statarena_app.archive_read_matches m
   WHERE m.season=$1 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM published) AND ($3='all' OR m.competition_id=$3)
    AND ($4='' OR position($4 IN m.search_teams)>0 OR position($4 IN m.search_players)>0)
   ORDER BY m.ordinal LIMIT $6::integer OFFSET (SELECT (page-1)*$6::integer FROM bounds)
  ) rows) AS matches
detail:
/*vega:archive-detail*/
WITH live AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT statarena_app.archive_source_fence($1) AS source_fence),
 published AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT p.season FROM statarena_app.archive_read_editions p,live
  WHERE p.season=$1 AND p.version=$2 AND p.revision=$4 AND p.source_fence=live.source_fence
 )
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM published) AS ready,
 (SELECT jsonb_build_object('listing',m.listing,'goals',m.goals)
  FROM statarena_app.archive_read_matches m WHERE m.season=$1 AND m.match_key=$3
   AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM published) ORDER BY m.ordinal LIMIT 1) AS match
insert_matches:
INSERT INTO statarena_app.archive_read_matches(season,ordinal,match_key,competition_id,search_teams,search_players,listing,goals)
SELECT $1,x.ordinal,x.match_key,x.competition_id,x.search_teams,x.search_players,x.listing,x.goals
FROM jsonb_to_recordset($2::jsonb) AS x(ordinal integer,match_key text,competition_id text,search_teams text,search_players text,listing jsonb,goals jsonb)
count: SELECT count(*)::integer AS matches FROM statarena_app.archive_read_matches WHERE season=$1
list:
SELECT edition AS season FROM statarena_app.catalog_editions WHERE catalog='archive-season'
GROUP BY edition ORDER BY edition
index_seasons:
SELECT s.id FROM statarena_app.catalog_editions idx
JOIN statarena_app.cat_archive_results_index_seasons s ON s.resource_id=idx.resource_id
WHERE $1='results' AND idx.catalog='archive-index' AND idx.scope='results' AND idx.edition=''
UNION SELECT s.id FROM statarena_app.catalog_editions idx
JOIN statarena_app.cat_archive_goals_index_seasons s ON s.resource_id=idx.resource_id
WHERE $1='goals' AND idx.catalog='archive-index' AND idx.scope='goals' AND idx.edition=''
